steps: lua:local s=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) s.signInfoLoaded_=false s:loadSignInfo(function() if not xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('sign_in') then xyd.WindowManager.get():openWindow('sign_in',{}) end end)
